dataset.description: SYNTHETIC evaluation set for LG-SOTF: hand-written alerts in canonical and vendor formats (documentation IP ranges, example.com names, made-up identifiers). Labels are assigned by construction, not by analysts reviewing real incidents. Use it to test the pipeline, never to claim detection accuracy.

notes: The dataset is synthetic: hand-written alerts with labels assigned by construction. It exercises the pipeline; it says nothing about accuracy on real customer telemetry.
Runs that stopped for analyst review or action approval were recorded as 'unreviewed': the harness never supplies an analyst decision.
